questions.explain: AI is everywhere, right? Naturally, global leaders gathered in Geneva to figure out a common framework for regulating it so that it remains safe and ethical for everyone.

questions.q: Who was appointed as the new Chief Vigilance Commissioner (CVC) of India in late October 2025?
questions.explain: Sanjay Varma has taken the helm. It’s a crucial role in maintaining transparency in our government departments, so keep an eye on his initiatives over the next few months.
